Microcement in Wishaw and the Central Belt

Darren installs microcement on floors, walls, bathrooms and wet rooms across Wishaw, Motherwell, Glasgow, North Lanarkshire and the Central Belt. It is seamless and waterproof, it can go over solid tiles, worktops and furniture, and he is approved by Luna Plaster, who trained him in Coventry.

Call 07767 446273 WhatsApp Us

Subtle, but Robust

"Microcement is a more subtle finish in my eyes, but a more robust product, which can be installed on floors to create a seamless, elegant look, and also in bathrooms and wet rooms, completely waterproof and seamless."

Darren, DRN Plastering Co

It can be installed over tiles and over many other materials, such as worktops and furniture. It comes in a great range of colours, and bespoke colours can be matched.

Trained and Approved by Luna Plaster

"We completed our training with Luna Plaster in Coventry. Luna Plaster is the sister company to Forcrete, a well recognised company. We have been approved by Luna to use their products and services, and all of the Luna products come with warranties and guarantees as long as we strictly follow their installation steps."

Darren, DRN Plastering Co

Bathrooms and Tiles

Can it go in a bathroom? Yes: microcement is a completely seamless and waterproof system. Can it go over tiles? Yes, as long as none of the tiles are loose and the background is solid.
